name: boj_get_policy_rate
description:
The Bank of Japan's operating-target rate: the uncollateralised overnight call money rate, in percent, monthly average, from FRED (IRSTCI01JPM156N, OECD series). FRED's Japanese discount-rate series ended in 2017, so it is not offered.
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): rate_type (call_money; default call_money); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For JGB yields use boj_get_jgb_yield. FRED series need FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); without it they fail with a message saying so.
Example: {"rate_type": "call_money", "recent_periods": 24}

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
